content:
alex: FYI — customer `Brightline` reporting bursts of 5xx / 504s to the hosted inference endpoint starting ~08:15 UTC. Multiple tenants affected. :rotating_light:
sofia: hitting us too, seeing p95 jump to 9s and a tsunami of queued requests in the batcher.
sofia: stack: hosted-gateway -> ingress-batcher -> continuous-batcher pool -> model-worker
ingress-sre: can you paste the gateway logs and batcher depths?
sofia: gateway logs (snip):
```
[2026-03-18T08:14:53Z] INFO incoming_requests=1248 in_flight=512 dropped=0
[2026-03-18T08:15:02Z] WARN enqueue_time_ms_p95=4800 queue_depth=10240
[2026-03-18T08:15:07Z] ERROR 504 gateway_timeout request_id=rid_8c12
```
```
batcher metrics (prom): continuous_batch_queue_depth{pool="cbatch-eu"} 10240
continuous_batch_dequeued_rate 120/s
continuous_batch_pending_batches 420
continuous_batch_process_time_p95 6500
```
devon: that queue_depth is > configured max (8192). Looks like backlog growth due to slow dequeues from model-worker. Are workers seeing OOM/GC?
mira: model-worker logs show frequent long KV cache misses and repeated long steals:
```
WARN kvcache_miss=1.0 seq_len=2048 decode_ms=1200 -> fallback slow-path
WARN gpu_util=98% mem_free=200MB scheduling_delay_ms=300
```
opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-312 (severity=high) — auto-notifications sent to oncall.
support-bot: Customer Brightline: "We saw dozens of 504s between 08:15–08:32, app impact" — they provided request ids.
alex: immediate mitigation options? throttling ingress? reduce batching window? drain batcher?
ingress-sre: Patch suggestion: temporarily reduce continuous-batcher max_batch_delay from 25ms -> 8ms to reduce large batches and speed dequeues. Also cap queue depth to 6k and enable backpressure to gateway.
sofia: can we also route Brightline to a lower-latency model variant (quantized) as fallback to clear backlog?
devon: quick repro steps I ran: replayed a 1.2k rps tail-heavy trace against staging: within 90s queue_depth climbs past 8k and p95 times out. Repro command: 
```
wrk -t16 -c400 -d120s --script=taily.lua https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate
```
mira: root cause hypothesis: a hot tenant causing continuous-batcher backlog because model-worker slow path (KV misses + long decode) + large batched sequences (avg seq_len spiked). The batcher doesn't shed early enough and queue grows past configured soft limit.
alex: action items: (1) ingress-sre apply temporary gating (cap queue to 6k & short batch delay) PR already drafted, (2) dev infra to recycle 2 worker pods with high gpu_util, (3) product to notify Brightline support we have mitigation in flight.
sofia: executing worker recycle now: pods restarted at 08:23:14Z.
ingress-sre: gating config pushed at 08:23:40Z, active. Watching metrics.
sofia: p95 dropped to 1.2s and queue_depth trending down to 2.6k within 4m. 504s stopped after 08:28. :white_check_mark:
devon: postmortem notes to capture: add earlier queue-shedding logic for continuous-batcher when avg_seq_len > 1024; surface tenant-level burst protection; tighter kvcache telemetry for hot misses.
mira: follow-up: schedule a runbook update + create a small load test harness that reproduces tail-heavy seq_len spikes.
alex: assigning owners: ingress-sre -> gate+config, devon -> batcher logic, mira -> runbook + load-test. I'll draft the customer message now.
support-bot: Customer update sent at 08:37Z: "We applied mitigations (ingress gating + worker recycle). Please confirm if you still see errors."
Brightline (external): "Error rate normalized, thank you — please keep us posted." :pray:
sofia: leaving this open to track followups; will file follow-up ticket for permanent fixes.
alex: closing notes: temporary mitigations were effective; plan = code fix + runbook + targeted canary for rollout.
